content.value_statement: ISMS audits require clear scope, evidence, and risk-based priorities. This skill guides ISO 27001 audit planning, control testing, and readiness work.
actual_capabilities: Outlines risk-based ISMS audit program planning and scheduling.
Maps audit work to ISO 27001 and ISO 27002 control areas.
Guides evidence review for policies, procedures, controls, and management records.
Supports certification audit preparation for Stage 1 and Stage 2 reviews.
Defines audit performance metrics for findings, remediation, and control effectiveness.
limitations: Does not perform accredited ISO 27001 certification decisions.
Does not replace qualified auditors or legal compliance advice.
Does not include the named audit automation scripts in this package.
Requires organization-specific scope, assets, risks, and evidence to be useful.

use_cases.title: Plan an Internal ISMS Audit
use_cases.description: Create a risk-based audit scope, schedule, and evidence plan for ISO 27001 controls.

use_cases.title: Prepare for Certification Review
use_cases.description: Check readiness for Stage 1 and Stage 2 certification activities before an external audit.

use_cases.title: Assess Security Control Evidence
use_cases.description: Review control implementation evidence and prioritize findings by security risk and compliance impact.

prompt_templates.title: Create Audit Scope
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define the scope for an internal ISO 27001 ISMS audit. Include assets, teams, control areas, and evidence sources.

prompt_templates.title: Build Evidence Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an evidence checklist for auditing ISO 27001 access control, incident management, risk assessment, and management review processes.

prompt_templates.title: Review Audit Findings
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these ISMS audit findings and help classify severity, affected controls, root causes, and remediation owners.

prompt_templates.title: Design Audit Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a 12-month risk-based ISMS audit program for a multi-site organization with cloud services, regulated data, and prior major findings.

output_examples.input: Plan our annual ISMS audit program for a mid-sized technology company.
output: A quarterly review schedule for high-risk systems and annual reviews for standard processes.
A scope map covering access control, incident response, supplier security, cloud configuration, and management review.
An evidence plan covering policies, risk records, tickets, training records, logs, and prior finding closure.

output_examples.input: Help prepare for an ISO 27001 Stage 1 audit.
output: A readiness checklist for ISMS scope, risk assessment method, statement of applicability, policies, and management review records.
A gap list for missing documents, unclear ownership, outdated risk treatment records, and weak evidence traceability.
A preparation plan assigning owners, evidence deadlines, and review meetings before the certification body visit.

output_examples.input: Prioritize these access control audit findings.
output: A severity ranking based on privilege exposure, affected systems, compensating controls, and regulatory impact.
Suggested remediation actions for account reviews, authentication controls, privileged access approval, and monitoring evidence.
A concise management summary that separates urgent security risk from process improvement items.

best_practices: Define audit criteria, scope, and evidence sources before reviewing controls.
Keep audit independence clear between assessors and remediation owners.
Link every finding to evidence, affected controls, risk impact, and an accountable owner.
anti_patterns: Do not run audits without documented ISO 27001 criteria and approved scope.
Do not treat automated scan results as complete evidence of control effectiveness.
Do not ignore administrative and physical controls when technical issues are visible.

faq.question: Can this skill certify an organization against ISO 27001?
faq.answer: No. Certification requires an accredited certification body. This skill supports preparation, internal review, and evidence organization.

faq.question: What inputs improve the audit guidance?
faq.answer: Provide audit scope, assets, control areas, risk records, prior findings, policies, and available evidence sources.

faq.question: Does it cover ISO 27002 controls?
faq.answer: Yes. It references ISO 27002 control assessment areas such as organizational, technical, physical, and operational controls.

faq.question: Can it help prioritize audit findings?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize findings by risk, control impact, evidence strength, and remediation urgency.

faq.question: Is this suitable for external audit preparation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help prepare documentation and evidence for Stage 1, Stage 2, and surveillance audits.

faq.question: Does the package include working audit scripts?
faq.answer: No. The skill describes audit workflows, but this package only includes example support files.
